text: XVII. 1. Aṭṭhahi bhikkhave ākārehi itthi purisaṃ bandhati. Katamehi aṭṭhahi? 2. Rūpena bhikkhave itthi purisaṃ bandhati, hasitena bhikkhave itthi purisaṃ bandhati, bhaṇitena bhikkhave itthi purisaṃ bandhati, gītena bhikkhave itthi purisaṃ bandhati, [page 197] XVIII. 1-XIX. 1 Mahā-Vagga. 197 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...]\ roṇṇena bhikkhave itthi purisaṃ bandhati, ākappena bhikkhave itthi purisaṃ bandhati, vanabhaṅgena bhikkhave itthi purisaṃ bandhati, phassena bhikkhave itthi purisaṃ bandhati. Imehi kho bhikkhave aṭṭhah'; ākārehi itthi purisaṃ bandhati. Tehi bhikkhave sattā subaddhā yeva pāsena baddhā ti.
